description: Find any tool on this connection by what it should do, including the many your list leaves out: query in words ("timestamp a text", "private messages", "wake me on a reply"), or toolset by name. Each hit has the tool's description, input schema and annotations, listed (whether your list has it), call (how to call it) and toolset_url (a URL that lists its toolset). Without query or toolset: every toolset with its tools.

query.description: What the tool should do, in words

toolset.description: A toolset's name: its tools in full
